Flow.description: Shows the Lead's stage and moves it on: New to Contacted, Unqualified, Qualified or Converted; Contacted to Unqualified, Qualified or Converted, or stays Contacted with a changed remark or follow-up; Qualified to Converted or Unqualified. Each move asks for that stage's fields. Converted opens the Convert Lead flow for the bill. Unqualified and converted Leads are shown read-only.
Flow.label: Lead Stage
